assessments.summary: The supplied work gives sound standalone arguments for input-conditioned marginal preservation, posterior-measure reconstruction and Carathéodory reduction, and the algebraic Q0 witnesses and coercive-window inversion. It also conditionally establishes the claimed Q0 optimum and pointwise bound for the locally encoded 30-row system. However, the authoritative Gohari–Liu–Nair equations (19a)–(19p), their side conditions, and the definitions of the governed B and V_Q functionals are neither supplied nor admitted as dependencies. Therefore the record cannot verify that the local term audit and hard-coded rows exactly exhaust and reproduce the externally named system. No decisive internal error or counterexample is shown, so invalidity is not established.
scopeQualifications: The G,K marginalization is verified only for the supplied class of terms involving exactly one of Y, Z, G, or K, with other arguments drawn from D and X; applicability to every branch and side condition of Theorem 9 is conditional on the unverified term audit being exhaustive.

The receiver-cardinality result is established for finite-grid functionals depending only on the sampled mutual-information curves through the stated Markov identities; its application to the named grid-restricted 30-row value is conditional on that value having exactly this dependence.

The equality inf_{G,K} V_{Q0}(G,K) = inf_m V_{Q0}(m,m^circ) = c is established for the locally reconstructed row system, including the revealing-erasure construction and encoded lower-bound witnesses, but not independently for the externally governed V_{Q0}.

The bound V0(g,k) >= max{F(g),F(k)} and the resulting midpoint window are algebraically certified for the encoded rows. The additional relation B(G,K) >= V0(g,k) remains conditional on the missing authoritative definition and optimization order for B.
The provenance claims that the contribution ports accepted Yukon BSSC artifacts and retains verbatim submissions and exact checkers under source-artifacts/ are not independently evidenced.
These results are structural and finite-grid statements only; no capacity-frontier improvement is established or required by the claim.
evidenceIssues: No allowed dependency evidence IDs were provided.
The exact text of Theorem 9 equations (19a)–(19p) and its two side conditions is absent, so omitted joint or output-conditioned G,K terms cannot be ruled out.
The executable checker validates algebra and labels for a locally encoded row system but does not compare that encoding against an independently supplied theorem specification.
The authoritative definitions of B(G,K), V_Q(G,K), V0(g,k), and their optimization/restriction relationship are not supplied.
The assertion that all relevant hierarchy posteriors lie on Q and that all 30 rows depend only on the preserved sampled curves is not independently verifiable from the bounded record.
